metadata.title: Wild mushroom cooking by tribal family | जंगली मशरूम के साथ बनी मिक्स वेज
metadata.description: A very special kind of Mushroom is found in the Jungle of Bastar region of Chhattisgarh. This mushroom is found for a few days between the month of August and September every year. The tribals of living in the forest collect it during that time. They dry it and preserve it to use through out the year.
